A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe Universal Beta Splatting, with corresponding main sections, Appendices A–D, Tables 1–10 and Figures 1–4. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original rendering experiments, efficiency measurements and ablations in Tables 1–3, with additional benchmark and parameterization results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the appendix's N3V evaluation, primitive-capacity study and rotation-parameterization comparison.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same covariance parameterization, conditional slicing, opacity modulation, losses and optimization. Appendix D revises its mathematical description to reference existing equations; it does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same scenes and tasks across NeRF Synthetic, Mip-NeRF360, 6DGS-PBR, D-NeRF, 7DGS-PBR and the appendix's N3V benchmark.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1 and 4–6, including the Gaussian baselines, DBS, and N3V's 4DGaussians and Ex4DGS comparisons.

E3.justification: The held-out-view evaluation, quality and efficiency metrics, 30K training iterations, dynamic batch size and final-iteration reporting are unchanged. No additional evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 3, primitive-capacity analysis in Table 9 and rotation-parameterization comparison in Table 10 are identical. The qualitative examples also retain the same content.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All experimental entries in Tables 1–10 and qualitative rendering results are unchanged. For example, both report 34.92 dB for UBS-6D on NeRF Synthetic and 32.22 dB for UBS-7D on N3V.

T1.justification: Appendix D replaces its universal d_i = max(tanh(d_i^raw/2), 0) definition with spatial distances from Equation 1 and nonspatial distances from Equation 11. Figure 4's Gaussian expression changes from exp(-4.5d^2) to exp(-4.5d), although Equation 21 retains d^2. The remaining mathematical analysis is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning unified Beta kernels, dimensional control, scene decomposition, Gaussian compatibility and rendering performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of kernel adaptivity, decomposition, compatibility and efficiency are retained. Figure 4's new domain note clarifies its illustration without changing the paper's substantive applicability claims or limitations.

D1.justification: Implementation, hyperparameters, initialization, GPU specifications and project-access information are unchanged. The appendix revisions concern mathematical definitions rather than newly disclosed implementation details.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion and cited works are identical. Bibliography entries move across pages 11–13 because of the added acknowledgment; no research reference is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 adds an acknowledgment section, shortens the Spatial-Orthogonal Cholesky paragraph heading in Appendix C.2 and rewrites the distance-definition paragraph in Appendix D. The broader narrative and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is reduced in size while retaining identical comparison images. Figure 4 retains its plotted curves but revises the Gaussian legend and adds a caption explaining the domain and illustrative symmetric extension. References also reflow.

improvement.justification: Replacing Appendix D's conflicting distance transformation with references to the existing spatial and nonspatial equations modestly improves specification consistency. Figure 4's domain clarification also helps interpretation. These gains are partly offset by its revised Gaussian legend disagreeing with unchanged Equation 21; the experimental evidence and core claims remain unchanged.
